guide.overview: A powerful **duelist Champion**, Artemis excels at **taunting enemies into duels**, all while striking a **perfect balance between offense and defense**. She shines even more when teamed up with **[Amazons]** allies for extra bonuses.

legacyPieces.name: Mistress
legacyPieces.reason: Artemis's signature gear. Boosts her Physical Defense and stacks Crit Rate with each skill cast. Also increases her damage dealt during duels, and if she defeats her target, all [Amazons] allies receive a damage bonus.

legacyPieces.name: Amazonium Alloy Shield
legacyPieces.reason: Significantly increases Physical and Spiritual Defense, and provides a strong, reliable shield. Artemis's damage scales with her Attack and Physical Defense, and the Amazonium Alloy Shield boosts both her duel damage and survivability.

legacyPieces.name: Improved Fear Gas Vial
legacyPieces.reason: Increases HP and Dodge. With control immunity and damage reduction during duels, the Dodge bonus makes Artemis even harder to take down in duels.

legacyPieces.name: Modoran Sonic Bomb
legacyPieces.reason: Significantly increases HP. Artemis needs to take heavy damage in duels, and a large HP pool ensures she survives to slash the target.
